notes: experiments/archive/ has a mixed layout. Experiment dirs nest one level deeper under 8 retained suites: ch4-basic-survival, ch5-emergent-behavior, ch6-scale-validation (README only, no child experiment dirs on disk), ch7-semantic-guardians, p1-physics, p2-sociology, p3-metaphysics, p6-bounded-continuity-branch. 42 experiment directories total, all with README.md. Per this phase's rule every entry gets family=archive. ID-token collisions exist WITHIN the phase across suites (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1 each appear in 2+ suites); for those colliding tokens I appended the slug to legacy_id (e.g. archive:1.1-survival vs archive:1.1-insurance; archive:1.2-amnesia/-lifeboat/-odyssean-pact/-semantic-guardian). Non-colliding tokens use plain archive:<ID> (e.g. archive:11.1, archive:1.1.1, archive:1.5, archive:3.2). p6 series uses the rule's archive-p6bc:<ID> prefix. All ch4/ch5/ch7 and p1/p2/p3 experiments are OLD-FORMAT: no YAML frontmatter, no ## Paper Feeds (paper_feeds=[]); experiment_type is inferred (single-run, except p1-physics/1.7-jq which is a 5-run/4-prompt-version multi-run study). Statuses for old-format entries are read from inline '**Status:**'/'**Result:**'/'Archive Role' text (pass/partial/timeout/design/archived/design-only); where no run was recorded I used design-only (ch7 DESIGN surfaces, p2 2.3-prison-break placeholder results, ch5 3.1-js-quine has no recorded run shown).
